messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #28934 is blocked by CI, macOS snapshot failing on only one test run. stack trace looks like a render nondet.
mira: which shard? can you paste the failing test name?
alex: macos-6
alex: test name: RenderPreviewSnapshotTest::handles-font-fallback
alex: logs: 
```
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch
- expected.png
+ actual.png
  at RenderPreviewSnapshotTest (preview_test.cc:214)
```
sam: thanks. quick sanity check — did we update any fonts or local fixture in this change? I skimmed the PR, looks unrelated.
jordan: no font files changed in the PR. this was a refactor around thumbnail generation only.
mira: ok. two options: update snapshot (if intentional) or rerun targeted shard to see if flake.
mira: i lean rerun first — if it flaps then we can bisect.
alex: agree. how do we do a targeted rerun for that shard? ci-bot, help?
ci-bot: Use the rerun command: `ci rerun --pr 28934 --shard macos-6` — queued.
sam: if rerun returns green, we should not update snapshot. only update if new behavior is intended.
alex: running rerun now.
alex: triggered: `ci rerun --pr 28934 --shard macos-6` :rocket:
ci-bot: Rerun queued by alex for PR 28934 (shard: macos-6). Buildkite link: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/987654
ci-bot: Build 987654 started.
mira: if it flakes consistently on reruns, we can try adding a stable test seed in the harness or add a short retry wrapper around that check.
jordan: quick thought — thumbnail renderer uses device pixel ratio from env on mac sometimes; tests running on pool machines with different DPR have caused diffs in the past.
alex: good call. sam, can you do one rerun and if it flakes twice, open a small follow-up to add deterministic DPR in test env?
sam: yes, i'll watch. ping me if rerun fails again.
ci-bot: Build 987654 passed (macos-6). :white_check_mark:
alex: nice — passing now. i'll hold off snapshot update.
mira: LGTM to merge once CI stays green for main shard set. alex, mark for merge when you're ready.
alex: will wait 10m for noise, then merge if stable. thanks all. :pray:
sam: thanks — nice quick turnaround.
ci-bot: Note: if flake recurs please add `flake-triage` label to the PR so QA can track it.
alex: added label `flake-triage`.
